# graviteeam_user_identities (Data Source)

Reads linked identities for a Gravitee AM user

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_user_identities" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  user_id   = graviteeam_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user

### Read-Only

- `items_json` (String) JSON string containing the user identities
